messages.text:
Here with already opinions on the farming food production, sadly currently tired and desmos does not want to work with me. But I made a lil formula which I think would work nicer. 

So I wanted something that started giving you the nice bonus of +3 food per land at the start, but curbs it to a lower level to prevent the absolutely exponential growth with a linear +3. So my late night ramblings give you a formula that now at about 2000 land lower the bonus to only about 1 food per 10 land, if I made it correctly.

Numbers not final, but I feel like it tapering off at higher counts is a good mechanic, where it should provide little to no bonusses at the more extremes. 

(x would be land, and y would be bonus food production. green is the line it approaches and eventually follows)
((If you want to imagine what the current vote winner would look like, trace a line trough the start of the purple graph and continue that)
